response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web engineer with nearly two decades of software experience, but the profile is fundamentally misaligned with this Principal Performance Architect role. There is no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, GPU/accelerator work, or deep-learning performance optimization. The closest relevant experience is low-latency systems programming in DLang and some C/C++ work at National Instruments, which falls well short of the hardware-software co-design and silicon architecture depth required.
strengths: Extensive engineering experience (18+ years) meeting the years-of-experience bar with a BS in CS
Some systems-level background: low-latency async I/O services in DLang, C/C++ IDE components, embedded exposure
Strong ownership and craftsmanship signals: open-source projects, workshops, and conference talks
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, or hardware performance-modeling experience whatsoever
No AI/deep-learning workload, GPU, or SIMD/MIMD architecture background
Career trajectory is web/product full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React), far from principal-level silicon performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Absence of SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator, GPU, or DNN performance-optimization background
Solid general systems programming and low-latency experience
